body: Quick safety check: Is this a project you created or one you trust? (Like your own code, a well-known open source project, or work from your team). If not,
take a moment to review what's in this folder first.
Claude Code'll be able to read, edit, and execute files here.
prompt.footer: Enter to confirm · Esc to cancel
